help_dbToken: Token required for database download/upload (/backup.html). Empty = unprotected.
lampa_sync_intro: Keeps watch progress, bookmarks, watched lists and search history the same on all devices with Lampa and the MovieSwipe plugin. Add the plugin as http://<ioBroker>:<port>/lampa.js?key=<sync key>, or enter the key under Settings → MovieSwipe on the device.
help_lampaSyncKey: One key for all devices. Without the key a device can neither read nor change the synced data.
help_lampaResetDevice: A device: its data replaces the copy and then the data of the other devices. All devices: the copy is built again by merging the data of every device.
confirm_lampaReset: The synced copy on ioBroker is cleared and built again as the devices sync. Continue?
help_lampaSyncPlugins: A plugin added on one device is offered to the others: it arrives switched off and the device asks whether to switch it on. Plugins are never removed or switched on by the sync.
